get.description: Authenticated user only; no owner/issuer/subject parameter or management role is accepted. Includes joined memberships and active applications in configured groups; excludes removed or unmanaged groups. Ordered by group ID in bytewise ascending order. Read-only: no admission, punishment, inbox or audit writes.

get.description: Authenticated user discovery directory for managed QQ groups with discoverable=true. Groups requiring student verification are visible only when the caller currently holds valid campus eligibility in that school; groups without student requirement remain publicly discoverable to authenticated users. Discloses only masked group numbers, admission summary and the caller's own joined/state.

max_value.description: Configured upper bound for randomized commands such as dice_sides.

seconds.description: Effective duration in seconds for timed dispositions or voluntary self_mute.

pity_remaining.description: Remaining attempts before guaranteed pity trigger when pity > 0.

missing_fields.description: Optional list of card template field keys not yet disclosed or available.

reason.description: Optional sanitized subcode for localized UI and bot prompts.

field.description: Optional request field name associated with validation or conflict errors.

retry_after_seconds.description: Optional remaining cooldown seconds; paired with the HTTP Retry-After header.

deadline.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

reminder.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

password_epoch.description: Dynamic password generation matched by this member.

last_play.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

muted_until.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

lease_until.description: Execution lease deadline; present only while executing.

attachments.description: Opaque media references. Backend proxy enforces current group access and the same expiry.

target.description: Owner key of the reported message author when the message was retained at report creation time; never includes message body.

number.description: Masked QQ group number; only its final four digits are shown.

password_epoch.description: Monotonic generation counter incremented whenever the dynamic password is set, rotated or cleared.

discoverable.description: Whether the group appears in the student-facing directory.

number.description: Optional real group number for create/update; omitted preserves the stored masked number.

expected_revision.description: 0 creates a group; otherwise must equal the current revision. A successful update increments revision by one.

password.description: Omitted preserves password; empty clears it (not allowed in password mode). Never returned or saved as plaintext.

discoverable.description: Optional directory visibility flag; defaults to false when omitted.

category.description: Optional directory category; empty when uncategorized.

description.description: Optional public group summary shown in the directory.

password_hint.description: Optional hint telling applicants where to obtain the dynamic password.

number.description: Masked QQ group number, same as GroupConfig.number.

member_count.description: Number of members whose joined fact is currently true.

pending_count.description: Sum of unresolved eligibility records (requested, awaiting_verification, grace, extended, removal_pending) and actions in pending/executing/unknown. One member can contribute to both counts.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next scan, or empty when exhausted. A filtered page may be empty with a nonempty cursor.

number.description: Masked group number, showing at most the final four digits; empty when not recorded.

joined.description: True only after the bot confirms group membership; an application does not imply joining.

state.description: Stored processing state for this authenticated user; removed memberships are excluded.

deadline.description: Current deadline in UTC, or null when none. Reads do not extend or restart the deadline.

requires_password.description: The group uses password mode. A previously accepted password is not listed as missing.

eligibility.description: Current prerequisite assessment, separate from recorded membership/approval or exemption. Any required unknown fact prevents eligible.

missing_conditions.description: Confirmed unmet conditions only. restricted discloses no blacklist reasons or management data.

unknown_conditions.description: Required facts whose provider explicitly reported unknown. A provider failure instead returns HTTP 503 with no partial page.

next_actions.description: UI action categories, not authorization grants. Unknown facts suggest refresh. Unsupported stages suggest contacting an administrator rather than repeating verification.

missing_card_fields.description: Optional card template field keys not yet disclosed or available for this group's card check; never contains field values.

password_hint.description: Optional hint describing where to locate the dynamic password; present only when requires_password is true and a hint is configured.

next_cursor.description: Last returned group ID if another page exists, or empty when exhausted.

text.description: Optional candidate card_template override; uses the group's stored card_template when omitted or empty.

CardPreviewCommand.description: Read-only management command; previews expected card rendering and missing profile fields without queuing bot actions.

CancelActionCommand.description: Management command; cancels a pending bot action without affecting executing or unknown actions.

RetryActionCommand.description: Management command; queues a controlled retry for a confirmed failed bot action.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next scan, or empty when exhausted.

number.description: Masked group number showing at most the final four digits; empty when not recorded.

password_hint.description: Optional hint describing where to locate the dynamic password when requires_password is true.

joined.description: True only when the caller's own membership has been confirmed by the bot.

state.description: Caller's own active membership or application state, or empty when none.

next_cursor.description: Last scanned group ID if another page may exist, or empty when exhausted.
